statements.proposition: This change keeps existing string-based edge conditions working as before (backward compatible).
statements.label: FALSE
statements.note: Concrete regression: has_cycles_with_exit now checks only `edge.condition_function is not None`, and graph_validate counts only callables as conditional, so graphs using string conditions on a cycle now raise 'Cycle detected without exit condition', and mixed string/unconditional edges no longer raise. add_conditional_edges now stores lambdas, so edge.condition becomes None for string keywords. The repository's own string-condition tests (e.g. test_cycle_detection_with_exit_condition, whose only change in this PR is a comment) pass at base and fail at head.
evidence: venv (python 3.11) with pip install -e autogen-core, autogen-agentchat, autogen-test-utils, autogen-ext, pytest, pytest-asyncio; run in sbx.py
